decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing builds directly on the firm's established voice and collaboration platforms, so the firm can assimilate customer feedback and improve the offer, making withdrawal unlikely.

The metropolitan data centre connection network leverages the firm's core fibre and data centre knowledge and has already shown positive market adoption, so the firm can readily learn from results and is very unlikely to drop it.

Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm's fibre and wavelength expertise, and in-house R&D and university cooperation support continued improvement, making the firm well positioned to keep it.

The voice number ordering portal is close to the firm's existing voice service platforms, enabling the firm to understand customer usage and refine the tool, though it is slightly less central than core network services.

Direct voice network connection is close to the firm's established network and voice capabilities, allowing the firm to recognise its value and adapt to market responses, keeping withdrawal probability low.
